text:
marie-eng: Quick question — for the Console experiment create flow, do we want to let users author per-variant routing expressions or keep it checkbox-based only? I can see cases where teams want 'US beta users only' routing as part of a variant.
eva-product: I'd prefer expressions but constrained. UX should offer templates (geo, header, user_tier) and a live traffic preview. Avoid freeform JS conditions.
samir-api: Agreed on constraints. From API side we should accept a tiny predicate DSL (JSON tree) and validate at creation. Example snippet:

```
{"all": [
  {"==": ["country", "US"]},
  {"in": ["user_tier", ["beta", "internal"]]}
]}
```

That maps cleanly to our routing engine and is serializable for audits.
luis-platform: Important: predicates must be evaluated fast at the routing layer. Keep operators minimal: ==, in, starts_with, regex (only for enterprise and rate-limited).
jonathan-sre: Also need per-variant safety caps. If variant A is overloaded we should have a fallback policy that redirects to default variant or a lower-latency model pool. Ops needs a hard QPS cap + soft throttling window.
marie-eng: How should the Console express fallback? A global default fallback toggle or per-variant fallback target? I worry about unexpected user-visible regressions.
tess-ux: Per-variant fallback target is clearer in UI (shows where traffic goes on fail). But add a global 'safe mode' that forces all experiment failures to baseline (for enterprise customers).
samir-api: Implementation detail: our ExperimentCreate API could accept fields:
- variants: [{name, seed_weight, routing_predicate, qps_cap, fallback_variant}]
- global: {fallback_policy, safe_mode}

We need stable names for telemetry too (see below).
marie-eng: Telemetry — what events do we emit? I propose:
- experiment.start
- experiment.assignment (variant, reason=predicate|random|fallback)
- experiment.fallback_trigger (variant_from, variant_to, reason=qps|error|predicate)
- experiment.rollforward (metric, delta)
jonathan-sre: Add experiment.overload_alert (variant, qps, pct_drop) to tie into SRE paging rules.
luis-platform: Also include sample of assigned_user_id salted with experiment id for deterministic seeding in logs. Do not log raw user ids in high-card telemetry; emit hashed_id for analytics.
samir-api: Small note on seeding: Console should expose seed_weight as percentage integer and show an implicit 'seed allocation' preview with rounding rules. E.g., 33/33/34 for three variants. Show how seed maps to traffic for top 1M users vs small cohorts.
tess-ux: UI idea: slider + small preview table that shows sample user ids (anonymized) and where they'd land given current seed + predicates. Helps catch config mistakes.
marie-eng: Rollout behavior question — automatic ramp on positive metrics? Product asked for 'auto-ramp on passes' but that introduces safety concerns.
eva-product: We want an opt-in auto-ramp with configurable success criteria and max step size (e.g., double every 30m up to 50%). Must require a primary metric and baseline comparison.
jonathan-sre: If we do auto-ramp, require canary drain windows and an automatic rollback hook on predefined regressions. Also limit concurrent auto-ramps per org to reduce blast radius.
samir-api: Tech debt: routing code currently evaluates predicate trees and then falls back to seed assignment. We'll need to add QPS checks before final assignment. Might be a small refactor but doable.
deploy-bot: deploy:experiment-service v3.4.1 promoted to staging at commit abc123 — includes predicate DSL parsing and qps cap fields.
marie-eng: OK next steps: I'll draft Console wireframes for per-variant routing blocks + fallback selector. @samir-api can you draft the API contract with sample payloads? @jonathan-sre please list SRE limits we must enforce server-side.
luis-platform: I'll run a perf profile of predicate evaluations on 100k req/s synthetic traffic and share numbers.
tess-ux: I'll mock the slider + sample preview and post screenshots. UX will default to simple mode (checkbox templates) and an advanced toggle for predicates.
eva-product: Thanks — target for API spec + wireframes by EOD Friday? :calendar:
marie-eng: Yup. Will sync up in stand if needed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
